Somebody just open sourced this github repo and now your Claude Code can run for hours without breaking.

 It is called Ruflo and it is number one on GitHub right now. 

So here is exactly how it works. It spins up over 60 AI agents that all operate as one coordinated team. Queen agents manage everything and tactical agents handle the actual work, researching, coding, testing, and reviewing. 

And because they share a collective memory, the whole system gets smarter after every single run. But here is what actually saves your credits. 

It reads how complex your task is and automatically routes it to the right model. So a simple task goes to a cheap model and a complex task goes to a powerful one. 

That means your token usage drops by 50 percent and it is completely free and open source and live right now.
